channel.title: Montaser Hussam — Engineering Notes
channel.description: Short, specific notes from building voice and agent systems.

item.title: An unscored prompt change is a guess
item.description: Eyeballing three example outputs is not measurement — it is a guess wearing the clothes of an experiment.

item.title: A working local demo says nothing about the network path
item.description: Localhost tells you the application logic is sound. It tells you nothing about NAT traversal, TURN relay cost, or mobile network jitter.

item.title: A payment webhook will fire twice
item.description: Payment providers retry webhook delivery on any ambiguous response — the idempotency key has to be there from the first handler written.

item.title: Measure latency where the user feels it
item.description: The number that predicts how a conversation feels is endpoint-detected-to-first-audible-token, measured on the server.
